name: seal-assurance-kit
description: Assurance kit for MCP tool mediation: verify decision receipts, test boundary conformance, audit policy coverage, and check finite monitor adequacy.

scripts.verify: node bin/seal verify fixtures/receipt-block.json && node bin/seal verify fixtures/receipt-allow.json && node bin/seal verify fixtures/receipt-crosstool.json
scripts.test: npm run --silent verify && npm run --silent test:drift && npm run --silent test:bypass && npm run --silent test:format && npm run --silent test:v3 && npm run --silent test:adequacy && npm run --silent test:receipt-diff && npm run --silent test:policy-sign && npm run --silent test:forged-binding && npm run --silent test:verify-authority-gate && npm run --silent test:scan-pin && npm run --silent test:scan-v2&& npm run --silent test:recipes && npm run --silent test:connect && npm run --silent test:red-corpus && npm run --silent test:pathological && npm run --silent test:vacuity && npm run --silent test:verify-profile
scripts.test:bypass: node test/expect-fail.cjs node bin/seal verify fixtures/receipt-bypass.json
